name: forecast
title: Forecast
description: A live forecast card for json-render chats: the next 24 hours with the chance of rain, or the next 10 days with each day's high, low and a range bar, and a switch between them, with its API route.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   ForecastCard: forecastCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: ForecastCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveForecastCard location={props.location || undefined} units={props.units} view={props.view ?? "daily"} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     ForecastCard: forecastLookup

Forecasts load from /api/forecast (installed at app/api/forecast/route.ts), backed by Open-Meteo. No API key needed.
